jobs.prompt:
Run repository verification for pull requests.

The default branch has no pull_request CI, which prevents ordinary Sentinel repair verification for this repository. Add a read-only pull_request workflow that runs local deterministic verification, including on PRs targeting development. Use the existing package check, with pinned toolchain/dependency installation following the repository lockfiles. Ensure type checking and the existing Bun and Deno regression suites actually execute. Use minimal contents:read permission, pin actions to full commit SHAs, with no secrets, publishing, deployments, external service mutation, self-hosted runners or pull_request_target. Run the actual command in the checkout. Validate the workflow YAML and show that a deliberately failing local fixture makes the check fail, then remove that deliberate change. Do not claim an actual PR event ran unless you observed one.

Target issue #145. You are the Astra ultra orchestrator. Delegate a bounded portion to a gpt-6.2-sol developer at max effort and a separate local verification task to a second Sol max developer if useful. Use collaboration.spawn_agent with fork_turns set to none, model gpt-6.2-sol, and reasoning_effort max. Supply a self-contained child brief and wait for completion. If the built-in delegation tool cannot pin both, launch a child with codex exec -m gpt-6.2-sol -c 'model_reasoning_effort="max"' in this isolated checkout; give each child exclusive file ownership. Report which children actually ran and their checks. Keep changes focused. Verify on the checkout, use synthetic fixtures, and do not change external services or deploy. If already satisfied on the base branch, provide evidence and finish without a change.
